help.goal: Uncover every square that has no mine under it. Clear them all and you win.
steps: Tap any square to start; the first tap is always safe.
In ⛏ dig mode, tap a square to uncover it.
Numbers say how many mines touch that square.
Tap 🚩 flag, then tap squares you think hide mines.
Tap 🔄 then tap again to wipe the run and restart.
notes: Long-press a square to flag it without leaving dig mode.
Tapping a number that already has that many flags around it opens the rest.
💣 counts the mines you have not flagged; ⏱ starts on your first tap.
